reasons.plausibility: L1₀ ordering in equiatomic FeCoNi is not a known equilibrium phase; the system tends to form disordered fcc or bcc-derived phases, making the proposed disorder-to-order transition physically unsupported.
reasons.testability: The test is clearly described with specific techniques (XRD, VSM, FORC) and a falsification criterion, but it relies on detecting an L1₀ phase that is unlikely to form, making the test practically uninformative.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (L1₀ ordering) that is not applicable to the FeCoNi system, so it would misdirect research effort.
